name: Dkhoun National Trading Co.
summary: Dkhoun National Trading Company specializes in the creation and global distribution of Arabic fragrances, reaching customers both within Saudi Arabia and internationally. Operating under its proprietary Dkhoun brand, the firm's diverse product portfolio features a range of body and hair perfumes, oud oils, traditional oud, and incense, which are sold through its digital e-commerce platforms and brick-and-mortar stores. The company's principal office is situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
